t: Pipulate: Local AI Workflows with Jupyter & Nix
s: Pipulate enables local, flexible AI workflows from Jupyter notebooks using Nix for portability. It aims to break LLM normalization by fostering outlier creativity and building personalized AI experiences.
sub: Building local AI workflows with Jupyter notebooks and Nix
Overcoming LLM normalization to foster AI outlier status
Structuring Pipulate repository for maintainability and nbdev integration
Converting Jupyter notebooks to AI workflow web apps
